sourceName: Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy (MOTIE), Korea
notes: These are MOTIE's official full-month semiconductor export totals for May-July 2026 (each topping the prior monthly record), the run-up to the bullet's Aug 1-20 figure of $26B. The Aug 1-20 number itself (and the 47.2% export-share figure) comes from a different outlet (Korea Herald / Korea Customs Service data) and is not repeated here to keep the whole series on one site (english.motir.go.kr), per the single-source rule. June's full-month total ($44.82B) is higher than July's ($41.01B), so the series is not strictly increasing month over month, but each is a record for its respective period type as stated in the source releases.
